Angle between the two working instruments = manipulation angle (ideal 60–90°).
Post-cholecystectomy pain c̅ abdominal tube: suspect bile leak → ERCP c̅ sphincterotomy/stent.

Head injury (GCS 8) c̅ respiratory distress: secure airway (c-spine protected) first in primary survey.
Alvarado: migration, nausea, rebound, fever (1 each) + leucocytosis (2) = 6.

LA classification grades reflux oesophagitis, not achalasia (Chicago classification for motility).

Hypocitraturia (not hypercitraturia) promotes recurrent stones; citrate inhibits crystallisation.
SADI-S: sleeve gastrectomy + single duodeno-ileal anastomosis.
Non-bilious, non-projectile vomiting c̅ normal exam at 6 weeks → GERD (pyloric stenosis: projectile vomiting c̅ olive mass).
Dog-ear (standing cone) excision removes the redundant skin fold at a wound end.
Oral candidiasis: KOH shows budding yeast c̅ pseudohyphae.
Z-plasty lengthens a contracted scar and changes its direction.
VAC: -125 mmHg, continuous or intermittent, ↑es granulation tissue, ↓es oedema and bacterial load.
Primary survey (ABC) comes first; needle decompression is done as part of the breathing step.
